aboutSection.intro: Established in 1990, Endo Techonology Group of Indutries. Is a trusted manufacturer and exporter of high-quality surgical instruments, offering a comprehensive portfolio of 3,000+ precision-engineered products.
aboutSection.description: Established in 1990, Endo Techonology Group of Indutries. Is a trusted manufacturer and exporter of high-quality surgical instruments, offering a comprehensive portfolio of 3,000+ precision-engineered products.
aboutSection.paragraph1: With decades of expertise, we combine advanced technology, skilled craftsmanship, and strict quality control to deliver reliable surgical instruments. Our custom manufacturing capabilities provide tailored solutions to meet diverse medical requirements.
aboutSection.paragraph2: Our commitment to quality is backed by ISO 9001, ISO 13485, CE Mark, FDA, and CPRA/EU-MDR registrations. We ensure precision, reliability, and customer satisfaction through every stage of manufacturing and global delivery.

departmentsPage.subtitle: From specialized surgical disciplines to advanced metallurgy and cleanroom passivation, explore how Endo Tech delivers surgical excellence.

clinicalSpecialties.name: General Surgery
clinicalSpecialties.description: High-precision scalpel handles, surgical scissors, tissue forceps, hemostatic clamps, and wound retractors engineered for all surgical disciplines.

clinicalSpecialties.name: Dental & Oral Maxillofacial
clinicalSpecialties.description: Ergonomic extracting forceps, dental elevators, periosteal instruments, scalers, and micro-pliers conforming to international dental standards.

clinicalSpecialties.name: ENT (Otolaryngology)
clinicalSpecialties.description: Specialized micro-laryngeal cup forceps, nasal speculums, ear curettes, and sinus endoscopy instruments for delicate head and neck surgery.

clinicalSpecialties.name: Orthopedics & Spine Surgery
clinicalSpecialties.description: High-torque Kerrison rongeurs, bone holding forceps, bone chisels, osteotomes, and plate benders made from high-strength German stainless steel.

clinicalSpecialties.name: Gynecology & Obstetrics
clinicalSpecialties.description: Vaginal speculums, uterine dilators, biopsy punches, ovum forceps, and caesarean instruments designed for patient safety and procedural efficiency.

clinicalSpecialties.name: Cardiovascular & Micro-Surgery
clinicalSpecialties.description: Micro-needle holders with tungsten carbide inserts, atraumatic vascular clamps, and micro-scissors for high-magnification surgical procedures.

manufacturingDivisions.title: Hot Drop-Forging & Precision Tooling
manufacturingDivisions.desc: High-tonnage forging presses creating closed-die blanks from certified medical-grade AISI 420 and German stainless steel.

manufacturingDivisions.title: CNC 5-Axis Milling & Micro-Machining
manufacturingDivisions.desc: German computer numerical control machining centers ensuring micron-level accuracy for bone punches, rongeurs, and micro-scissors.

manufacturingDivisions.title: Master Toolmaker Hand-Finishing & Assembly
manufacturingDivisions.desc: Generations of master metallurgical craftsmen hand-aligning tips, adjusting spring tensions, and balancing instruments for surgical feel.

manufacturingDivisions.title: Class 10,000 Cleanroom & Ultrasonic Passivation
manufacturingDivisions.desc: Multi-stage automated ultrasonic cleaning baths, nitric acid chemical passivation, and sterile barrier packaging conforming to ISO 13485.

aboutPage.missionTitle: Care with Trust... Dedicated to Surgical Precision.
aboutPage.missionText1: Founded in Sialkot, Pakistan – the world's historic hub for surgical instrument manufacturing – Endo Tech Group of Industries has grown into an international powerhouse supplying hospital networks, healthcare authorities, and premium distributor brands across 65+ nations.
aboutPage.missionText2: We operate under comprehensive Quality Management Systems conforming to ISO 9001:2015, ISO 13485:2016, European CE Medical Device Regulations (MDR), and US FDA Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP).

sustainabilityPage.introText: At Endo Tech Group of Industries, we believe that advancing healthcare must not come at the expense of our planet. Our green manufacturing initiatives in Sialkot integrate renewable energy, zero chemical discharge, and circular metallurgical recycling.

initiatives.title: 100% Recyclable Medical-Grade Steel
initiatives.desc: All AISI 420 and German stainless steel offcuts and swarf are 100% segregated and recycled into secondary industrial processes, achieving near-zero metallurgical scrap.

initiatives.title: Solar Powered Clean Facility
initiatives.desc: Our manufacturing campus operates a 250 kW on-site rooftop solar photovoltaic system, reducing carbon emissions by 180 metric tons annually.

initiatives.title: Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD) Effluent Plant
initiatives.desc: All electropolishing, ultrasonic washing, and passivating wastewater undergoes multi-stage chemical and biological treatment, recycling clean water back into processing.

initiatives.title: Eco-Friendly Biodegradable Packaging
initiatives.desc: Non-sterile bulk packaging uses 100% recycled unbleached cardboard and water-soluble protective coatings, eliminating single-use plastics.
